_meta.purpose: Single source of every user-facing string on rightnleft.com, in English and Spanish. Feeds both the reviewer's side-by-side page (npm run i18n:review) and, once the Spanish is signed off, the locale modules the page renders from.
_meta.status: Spanish reviewed and approved by Marco Arras (fluent), 3 September 2026. The draft was written by Claude and corrected where needed. "La Franja Morada" for the site name was approved as part of this pass — note it does not match the English og:image, which still reads "The Purple Strip"; a Spanish share card is a separate asset.
_meta.placeholders: {name} is substituted at runtime from real data. A translator may MOVE a placeholder anywhere the Spanish needs it, but must not rename, add or drop one. Placeholder names are listed per string in 'vars'.

register.why: Texas county election offices and Secretary of State voter materials use usted. The English is deliberately warm and plain, so usted here should stay plain rather than drifting formal — short sentences, no bureaucratic register. FLAGGED FOR REVIEWER: if tu reads better for this audience, it is a global change and worth making deliberately.
register.diacritics: Spanish values carry full diacritics, including ñ. The first draft of this file did not, which is not a style choice but incorrect Spanish — and two of the omissions changed meaning outright ("campana" is a bell, not a campaign; "senal" is not a word). npm run i18n:check now fails on a known list of these, so it cannot regress silently.

scope.covered: Site chrome: the estimator verdicts, the header and explainer, the mode bar, provenance tiles, the incumbency card, the authorship note, the method section, candidate and statement notes, presets.
scope.pass_two: Payload text is NOT here yet: the 67 official bill captions (~1315 words, and they need the bilingual treatment below), the outcome indicators and caveats (~1806 words), and our seven plain-language blurbs (~291 words). Those are keyed by item id and belong in a sidecar, public/data/quiz_89R.es.json, so the English payload stays byte-identical and the 'this is the exact file the page loaded' promise survives.

_meta.official_text_rule: The 67 bill captions are copied verbatim from the record and the page says so. A Spanish translation of an official English caption IS NOT the official caption. So Spanish captions ship as a clearly-labelled aid with the official English one tap away and marked as the record, exactly as plainLanguageNote already distinguishes our gloss from the record. Never replace, never present a translation as the caption.
_meta.markup:
Copy values may contain INLINE presentational markup — , , , , and the colour swatches — because those wrap specific words and move with them when a sentence is reordered. They may NOT contain structural markup (

,

,
    ,
    ): the code owns the shape of the page, the copy owns the words. The method paragraphs are the one exception to the inline rule, split into .lead and .body, because there the bold run is a whole sentence rather than a phrase inside one.

verdict.fewMarks.headline.en: Answer a few more and we can tell you something
verdict.fewMarks.headline.es: Responda unas cuantas más y podremos decirle algo
verdict.fewMarks.headline.where: Results readout, before the minimum answer count is reached.

verdict.fewMarks.caveat.en: So far you have answered {n} {votes}. We need at least {min}.
verdict.fewMarks.caveat.es: Hasta ahora ha respondido {n} {votes}. Necesitamos al menos {min}.
verdict.fewMarks.caveat.note: The {votes} slot receives an already-pluralised noun from plural() — see noun.vote.one / noun.vote.many. It replaced an English {s} suffix that could not work in Spanish.

verdict.weakLoad.headline.en: These votes can't really place you
verdict.weakLoad.headline.es: Estos votos no alcanzan para ubicarle
verdict.weakLoad.headline.where: Results readout when the answered votes carry too little partisan content to say anything.
verdict.weakLoad.headline.note: Must NOT sound like a failure by the reader. It is a statement about the votes, not about them.

verdict.weakLoad.caveat.en: On the ones you answered, Republicans and Democrats mostly voted the same way. So your answers do not say much about which party you are closer to — whichever way they fell.
verdict.weakLoad.caveat.es: En los que respondió, republicanos y demócratas votaron casi siempre del mismo modo. Así que sus respuestas no dicen mucho sobre a qué partido está más cerca, en ninguna dirección.

verdict.balanced.headline.en: You are split right down the middle
verdict.balanced.headline.es: Está dividido exactamente por la mitad
verdict.balanced.headline.where: Results readout, the genuine mixed result.

verdict.balanced.caveat.en: About as many of your answers matched Republicans as matched Democrats. This is the purple result.
verdict.balanced.caveat.es: Aproximadamente tantas de sus respuestas coincidieron con los republicanos como con los demócratas. Este es el resultado morado.
verdict.balanced.caveat.note: CRITICAL: this is the one verdict the project refuses to hand out cheaply. The Spanish must not sound more congratulatory than the English. 'El resultado morado' is a plain label, not a compliment. Reviewer: please check it does not read as praise.

verdict.crossover.headline.en: You lean toward {party}, but you cross over a lot
verdict.crossover.headline.es: Se inclina hacia {party}, pero cruza líneas a menudo
verdict.crossover.headline.where: Results readout: a lean with substantial crossover.
verdict.crossover.headline.note: Was {side} with an adjective. Spanish cannot take an adjective in that slot, so both languages now use the plural party noun from party.D / party.R.

verdict.crossover.caveat.en: Most of your answers matched {party}, but a big share matched {other} instead.
verdict.crossover.caveat.es: La mayoría de sus respuestas coincidieron con {party}, pero una parte considerable coincidió con {other}.

verdict.consistent.headline.en: You line up with {party} nearly every time
verdict.consistent.headline.where: Results readout, a consistent partisan result.

verdict.consistent.caveat.en: Almost all of your answers matched the same party.
verdict.consistent.caveat.es: Casi todas sus respuestas coincidieron con el mismo partido.

verdict.nearMiddle.headline.where: Results readout, near-zero lean that is NOT a genuine split.

verdict.nearMiddle.caveat.en: Not because you split between the parties — the votes you answered mostly fell close to the line between them anyway.
verdict.nearMiddle.caveat.es: No porque se divida entre los partidos, sino porque los votos que respondió ya caían cerca de la línea entre ellos.
verdict.nearMiddle.caveat.note: The distinction from verdict.balanced is the entire point of this string. It must be unmistakable that this is NOT the purple result.

q.officialNote.es: La pregunta de arriba es nuestro resumen en lenguaje sencillo. Este es el texto oficial del proyecto de ley, palabra por palabra. La Cámara votó {yeas} a favor, {nays} en contra.

intro.p1.en: Texas lawmakers vote yes or no on new laws. We took real votes from 2025 and hid who voted which way. Now you vote.
intro.p1.es: Los legisladores de Texas votan a favor o en contra de nuevas leyes. Tomamos votos reales de 2025 y ocultamos quién votó de qué manera. Ahora vota usted.
intro.p1.note: The English here is deliberately at a low reading level. Keep the Spanish equally plain; do not upgrade the vocabulary.

intro.p2.en: For each one we count how many Republicans said yes, and how many Democrats said yes. Mostly Republicans? We colour it red. Mostly Democrats? Blue. Both parties agreed? Grey — that vote doesn't tell us much about sides.
intro.p2.es: En cada uno contamos cuántos republicanos votaron a favor y cuántos demócratas votaron a favor. ¿Sobre todo republicanos? Lo pintamos de rojo. ¿Sobre todo demócratas? Azul. ¿Los dos partidos de acuerdo? Gris, porque ese voto no nos dice mucho sobre bandos.

intro.p3.en: Every answer you give becomes one dot. Dots on the left mean you agreed with Democrats. Dots on the right mean you agreed with Republicans. If your dots land on both sides, you don't fit neatly in one party. That's the purple part.
intro.p3.es: Cada respuesta que da se convierte en un punto. Los puntos a la izquierda significan que coincidió con los demócratas. Los de la derecha, con los republicanos. Si sus puntos caen en los dos lados, usted no encaja limpiamente en un solo partido. Esa es la parte morada.

intro.p4.en: Then we show you what these areas actually look like in Texas today — school funding, health coverage, and so on — with the source for every number.
intro.p4.es: Después le mostramos cómo están realmente estas áreas en Texas hoy: financiamiento escolar, cobertura de salud y otras, con la fuente de cada cifra.

intro.fine.en: Nobody's opinion decides the colours. They come from the actual vote counts, and you can check them on every question. The outcome numbers are real too, but a state ranking has many causes — we show you the numbers and the votes, and leave the connecting to you.
intro.fine.es: La opinión de nadie decide los colores. Salen de los conteos reales de votos, y usted puede verificarlos en cada pregunta. Las cifras de resultados también son reales, pero la posición de un estado tiene muchas causas: le mostramos las cifras y los votos, y la conexión la hace usted.

bias.heading.en: Doesn't this favour the people who have voting records?
bias.heading.es: ¿No favorece esto a quienes tienen historial de votos?
bias.heading.where: Incumbency card heading, directly under the three candidate scores.

bias.p1.en: It would, if we scored anyone else. So we don't. A score here needs one thing — the same bills, voted on by both of you. Only members of the Texas House have that. All {n} candidates above sit in the Texas House. Every one of the people they are running against does not:
bias.p1.es: Lo haría, si calificáramos a alguien más. Por eso no lo hacemos. Una calificación aquí necesita una sola cosa: los mismos proyectos de ley, votados por ambos. Solo los miembros de la Cámara de Representantes de Texas tienen eso. Los {n} candidatos de arriba están en la Cámara de Texas. Ninguna de las personas contra las que compiten lo está:
bias.p1.note: {n} arrives as a spelled-out word in English ('three'). For Spanish it must arrive as 'tres'. Resolved: word() in src/i18n.ts has a per-locale numeral list, so {n} arrives already spelled out in the right language.

bias.p2.en: So they get no number at all — not a low one, not an estimate. Any score we printed for them would be votes we made up.
bias.p2.es: Así que no reciben ninguna cifra: ni baja, ni estimada. Cualquier calificación que imprimiéramos para ellos serían votos que nos inventamos.

bias.p3.en: What stops this being a page about {n} Democrats. Under every one of the {items} questions we also show {total} sitting House members — {reps} Republicans and {dems} Democrats.
bias.p3.es: Lo que evita que esta sea una página sobre {n} demócratas. Debajo de cada una de las {items} preguntas mostramos también a {total} miembros en funciones de la Cámara: {reps} republicanos y {dems} demócratas.
bias.p3.note: Resolved: word() in src/i18n.ts has a per-locale numeral list, so {n} arrives already spelled out in the right language.

bias.p3b.en: They voted on the same bills you are answering ({lo}–{hi} of {items}), so they are scored the way the candidates are, on every question rather than a chosen few. If the Republican records land close to the Democratic ones on your answers, that is the finding, not a thumb on the scale.
bias.p3b.es: Votaron los mismos proyectos que usted está respondiendo ({lo}-{hi} de {items}), así que se califican igual que los candidatos, en cada pregunta y no en unas pocas escogidas. Si los historiales republicanos quedan cerca de los demócratas según sus respuestas, ese es el hallazgo, no un pulgar en la balanza.
bias.p3b.note: 'a thumb on the scale' is idiomatic English. 'un pulgar en la balanza' is understood but may not be idiomatic Texas Spanish. Reviewer: replace with whatever actually carries 'rigged in favour of one side'.

bias.p4.en: Where an opponent does leave a mark. On {acts} of the {items} there is a recorded action on the exact bill — a veto, or a bill named a must-pass priority. We show it under that question and we never add it to a tally.
bias.p4.es: Donde un oponente sí deja huella. En {acts} de las {items} hay una acción registrada sobre ese mismo proyecto: un veto, o un proyecto declarado prioridad obligada. La mostramos debajo de esa pregunta y nunca la sumamos a un conteo.

bias.fine.en: One rule picks all {total} of those names, and it cannot be tuned question by question. So if you think it is doing work it shouldn't, the rule is the thing to argue with — and every vote behind it is in {payload}. The other half of this answer is {authorLink}.
bias.fine.es: Una sola regla escoge los {total} nombres, y no se puede ajustar pregunta por pregunta. Así que si cree que está haciendo un trabajo que no debería, la regla es lo que hay que discutir, y cada voto detrás de ella está en {payload}. La otra mitad de esta respuesta es {authorLink}.
bias.fine.where: Bias card fine print. {authorLink} is an anchor to #author-card.

author.heading.en: Who made this, who paid for it, and what I have at stake
author.heading.es: Quién hizo esto, quién lo pagó y qué tengo en juego

author.built.en: I'm Marco Arras, and I built this on my own time. Nobody paid for it — no campaign, no party, no PAC, no organisation. There was no budget. The cost was evenings.
author.built.es: Soy Marco Arras y hice esto en mi propio tiempo. Nadie lo pagó: ninguna campaña, ningún partido, ningún PAC, ninguna organización. No hubo presupuesto. El costo fueron mis noches.
author.built.note: 'PAC' stays as PAC; it is the term used in US Spanish-language political coverage.

author.donation.en: I donate to the Democratic Party. You should know that before you read anything else here, and it is the reason this page is built the way it is rather than a footnote to it. I have a side. So the rule that picks the comparison members runs identically on both caucuses, a third of the questions are reserved for votes where the two parties agreed, the selection rule is named and published, and every vote, count and score sits in one file you can download and check. None of that asks you to trust me. That is the whole point of it.
author.donation.es: Yo dono al Partido Demócrata. Debería saberlo antes de leer cualquier otra cosa aquí, y es la razón por la que esta página está construida como está, no una nota al pie. Tengo un lado. Por eso la regla que escoge a los miembros de comparación funciona igual en las dos bancadas, un tercio de las preguntas se reserva para votos en los que los dos partidos estuvieron de acuerdo, la regla de selección tiene nombre y está publicada, y cada voto, conteo y calificación está en un archivo que usted puede descargar y verificar. Nada de eso le pide que confíe en mí. Ese es exactamente el punto.
author.donation.where: Authorship card, second paragraph. MUST stay in this position.
author.donation.note: HIGHEST STAKES STRING IN THE FILE. It is the disclosure the whole project's credibility rests on, and the verifier asserts it appears before the editorial-choice paragraph. Reviewer: check it reads as a plain admission and not as a boast about transparency.

author.job.en: What I do for a living. I work as a solutions architect in energy. The sector buys and sells power, which overlaps the utilities votes on this page, so you should weigh what I say about those accordingly. My employer had no involvement in this, did not fund it and did not review it. I do no paid political work of any kind.
author.job.es: A qué me dedico. Trabajo como arquitecto de soluciones en el sector energético. El sector compra y vende energía, lo cual se cruza con los votos sobre servicios públicos de esta página, así que debería ponderar en consecuencia lo que yo diga sobre esos. Mi empleador no tuvo participación en esto, no lo financió y no lo revisó. No hago ningún tipo de trabajo político remunerado.
author.job.note: 'utilities' in the Texas regulatory sense. Reviewer: 'servicios publicos' is the standard rendering but confirm it does not read as 'public services' generally.

author.races.en: I picked these three races. Governor, Lieutenant Governor and U.S. Senate. That is an editorial decision, not a measurement, and it is the choice most worth arguing with. I picked them because all three Democratic candidates sit in the Texas House, which means their records can be checked against your answers vote for vote. Their opponents cannot be, so this page gives them no score at all rather than an invented one.
author.races.es: Yo escogí estas tres contiendas. Gobernador, Vicegobernador y Senado de Estados Unidos. Esa es una decisión editorial, no una medición, y es la elección que más vale la pena discutir. Las escogí porque los tres candidatos demócratas están en la Cámara de Texas, lo que significa que sus historiales se pueden comparar con sus respuestas voto por voto. Los de sus oponentes no, así que esta página no les da ninguna calificación en lugar de darles una inventada.
author.races.note: 'Lieutenant Governor' as 'Vicegobernador' is the standard Texas Spanish rendering. Confirm against the Texas SOS Spanish ballot language.

author.why.en: Why I made it. Almost everything that reaches people about how their state is actually governed arrives pre-framed by someone who wants something. The votes themselves are public, tedious, and genuinely hard to get at. I wanted a way to see the record before seeing the label, and to hand over the entire file so that anyone can check the record is what I say it is.
author.why.es: Por qué lo hice. Casi todo lo que llega a la gente sobre cómo se gobierna realmente su estado llega ya enmarcado por alguien que quiere algo. Los votos en sí son públicos, tediosos y de verdad difíciles de alcanzar. Quería una manera de ver el registro antes de ver la etiqueta, y de entregar el archivo completo para que cualquiera pueda verificar que el registro es lo que yo digo que es.

author.contact.en: If something here is wrong, tell me: arras.marco@gmail.com. Corrections get made, and noted on the page.
author.contact.es: Si algo aquí está mal, dígamelo: arras.marco@gmail.com. Las correcciones se hacen y se anotan en la página.

mode.shortDesc.en: Seven of the session's biggest fights — the bills the Lieutenant Governor made priorities or the Governor vetoed. Six of the seven split cleanly along party lines, so this version can mostly only tell you which party you lean toward. Switch to all {n} to find where you cross over.
mode.shortDesc.es: Siete de las peleas más grandes de la sesión: los proyectos que el Vicegobernador hizo prioridades o que el Gobernador vetó. Seis de las siete dividieron limpiamente por línea partidista, así que esta versión casi solo puede decirle hacia qué partido se inclina. Cambie a los {n} votos para encontrar dónde cruza.
mode.shortDesc.note: Corrected: an earlier draft of this key held a shorter, stale variant that is not what the page renders.

mode.fullDesc.en: All {n} votes: one per bill, spread across 20 subject areas, including the ones where Republicans and Democrats agreed. Those are the votes that can show you crossing party lines.
mode.fullDesc.es: Los {n} votos: uno por proyecto, repartidos en 20 materias, incluidos aquellos en los que republicanos y demócratas estuvieron de acuerdo. Esos son los votos que pueden mostrarle cruzando líneas partidistas.
mode.fullDesc.note: Corrected: an earlier draft of this key held a shorter, stale variant.

cand.note.en: All three sat in the same chamber and are running for different offices, so these are three separate readouts, not a ranking. They voted together on most party-line bills, so expect the numbers to sit close together — where they diverge is the interesting part. Coverage over these {items} votes: {coverage}. A vote they missed is dropped for them alone, not counted against them.
cand.note.es: Los tres estuvieron en la misma cámara y compiten por cargos distintos, así que estas son tres lecturas separadas, no una clasificación. Votaron juntos en la mayoría de los proyectos de línea partidista, así que espere que las cifras queden cerca; donde se separan es la parte interesante. Cobertura sobre estos {items} votos: {coverage}. Un voto que no emitieron se descarta solo para ellos, no se cuenta en su contra.
cand.note.where: Under the three candidate score cards.

stmt.note.en: A Texas member may file a statement saying the Journal recorded them wrongly. The recorded vote is the official act and is what is scored here; the statement is shown beside it, never applied in its place.
stmt.note.es: Un miembro de Texas puede presentar una declaración diciendo que el Diario lo registró mal. El voto registrado es el acto oficial y es lo que se califica aquí; la declaración se muestra al lado, nunca se aplica en su lugar.
stmt.note.note: 'the Journal' is the House Journal, a specific document. 'el Diario de la Camara' on first mention. Reviewer: confirm the official Spanish name if one exists.

preset.note.en: The first two produce almost the same net lean — a single blended swatch would render both as the same purple. They are opposite findings, so the readout separates them on partisan load.
preset.note.es: Los dos primeros producen casi la misma inclinación neta: una sola muestra mezclada pintaría ambos del mismo morado. Son hallazgos opuestos, así que la lectura los separa por carga partidista.

ui.officialCaption.es: Título oficial, tal como fue registrado

ui.translationNotice.en: Spanish here is our translation, not an official version. The official text of every bill is in English and is one tap away on each question.
ui.translationNotice.es: El español aquí es nuestra traducción, no una versión oficial. El texto oficial de cada proyecto de ley está en inglés y está a un toque de distancia en cada pregunta.
ui.translationNotice.where: NEW STRING. Sitewide notice on the Spanish pages only.
ui.translationNotice.note: This is the string that keeps the project's 'copied word for word' promise honest in Spanish. It is not optional.

Por eso ve una postura en este proyecto y nunca un porcentaje.

method.where.body.en: These are real votes the Texas House took. We use one vote per bill, so no bill is asked about twice. Then we sort the bills into 20 subject areas — the same list the state's own library uses — and take at most {perCat} from each area.
method.where.body.es: Son votos reales que emitió la Cámara de Texas. Usamos un voto por proyecto, así que ningún proyecto se pregunta dos veces. Después clasificamos los proyectos en 20 materias, la misma lista que usa la biblioteca legislativa del estado, y tomamos como máximo {perCat} de cada materia.

method.notFights.lead.en: Why some questions are not close fights.
method.notFights.lead.es: Por qué algunas preguntas no son peleas cerradas.

method.notFights.body.en: About {reserve} out of every 100 spots are saved for votes where Republicans and Democrats agreed. We do that on purpose. If we only picked the big fights, every answer you gave would land at one end or the other, and nobody could ever come out purple. The rule we follow is written down and named {rule}, so you can check we did not change it to get a nicer answer.
method.notFights.body.es: Cerca de {reserve} de cada 100 lugares se reservan para votos en los que republicanos y demócratas estuvieron de acuerdo. Lo hacemos a propósito. Si solo escogiéramos las peleas grandes, cada respuesta que diera caería en un extremo o en el otro, y nadie podría salir morado. La regla que seguimos está escrita y se llama {rule}, así que puede comprobar que no la cambiamos para obtener una respuesta más agradable.

method.seven.body.en: We picked these by hand, but not by our own opinion. Each one is a bill the Lieutenant Governor called a top priority, or a bill the Governor vetoed. Those are their published lists, not ours. Each question shows why it made the list. Six of the seven split the two parties sharply — that is what a headline fight is.
method.seven.body.es: Las escogimos a mano, pero no según nuestra propia opinión. Cada una es un proyecto que el Vicegobernador declaró prioridad, o que el Gobernador vetó. Esas son sus listas publicadas, no las nuestras. Cada pregunta muestra por qué entró en la lista. Seis de las siete dividieron a los dos partidos con claridad, y eso es lo que hace una pelea de portada.

method.words.body.en: Every question is the bill's official summary, copied word for word. We did not rewrite it to sound better or worse. How each member voted comes from the official House Journal where we could match it (journal), and otherwise from a scrape (scrape). The table tells you which, for every vote.
method.words.body.es: Cada pregunta es el resumen oficial del proyecto, copiado palabra por palabra. No lo reescribimos para que suene mejor ni peor. Cómo votó cada miembro viene del Diario oficial de la Cámara donde pudimos hacer la correspondencia (journal), y en los demás casos de una extracción automática (scrape). La tabla le dice cuál, en cada voto.
method.words.body.note: The <span class="src"> values "journal" and "scrape" are left in English on purpose: they are the literal tokens shown in the table column, so translating them here would stop the sentence matching what the reader sees.

method.check.body.en: Every vote, count and score behind this page sits in one file: {link}. That is the exact file this page loaded, not a copy we made for show. Take it: the data is public domain (CC0) and the code is MIT. If you reuse an outcome figure, please carry its caveat with it.
method.check.body.es: Cada voto, conteo y calificación detrás de esta página está en un solo archivo: {link}. Es el archivo exacto que cargó esta página, no una copia hecha para aparentar. Tómelo: los datos son de dominio público (CC0) y el código es MIT. Si reutiliza una cifra de resultados, por favor lleve su advertencia con ella.
method.check.body.note: The licence is stated HERE rather than in a separate section because this is the paragraph that already hands the file over, and a grant of reuse belongs next to the thing being granted. The last sentence is a request, not a condition: CC0 cannot require it, and pretending otherwise would misdescribe the licence.

page.title.note: Was "The Purple Strip — PlainRecord", which contains nothing anyone searches for: no Texas, no voting record, no candidate name. The brand stays in the h1 and og:title; the title element is for search.

page.description.en: A blind quiz on real Texas House votes. Answer without knowing which party took which side, then see where you land and where Texas actually stands.
page.description.es: Un cuestionario a ciegas sobre votos reales de la Cámara de Texas. Responda sin saber qué partido tomó qué lado, y después vea dónde queda usted y cómo está Texas en realidad.

page.langSwitch.note: Deliberately reversed: the English page says "En español" and the Spanish page says "In English".

page.translationNotice.en: Everything we wrote ourselves is in Spanish. The official bill captions stay in English, exactly as they appear in the record — translating them would make them something other than the record.
page.translationNotice.es: Todo lo que escribimos nosotros está en español. Los títulos oficiales de los proyectos de ley se quedan en inglés, tal como constan en el registro: traducirlos los convertiría en otra cosa.
page.translationNotice.where: Shown on the Spanish page only, after the header explainer.
page.translationNotice.note: Reworded and MOVED. It used to sit directly under the language switch, which made a disclaimer the first thing a Spanish reader saw on a phone — before the page had said what it was. It also led with what the page is not ("una traducción nuestra, no una versión oficial"), which reads apologetic. It now leads with what the reader does get, then the limit, then the reason for the limit. The English value is never rendered; it exists so the key set stays symmetric.

method.denominator.lead.es: Dos cifras de votos sin división partidista, y por qué.

method.denominator.body.en: The percentage in the tiles above counts all {items} questions. The crossCuttingShare field in the data file is measured over the rule-selected votes only, so it is a slightly different number. That is deliberate: it exists to check the rule, and the seven headline bills were picked by hand rather than by the rule — six of them split the parties sharply, so counting them would make the rule look more one-sided than it is. Both numbers are honest and neither is the other one rounded.
method.denominator.body.es: El porcentaje de los recuadros de arriba cuenta las {items} preguntas. El campo crossCuttingShare del archivo de datos se mide solo sobre los votos escogidos por la regla, así que es una cifra ligeramente distinta. Eso es a propósito: existe para comprobar la regla, y los siete proyectos principales los escogimos a mano y no por regla; seis de ellos dividieron a los partidos con claridad, así que contarlos haría parecer la regla más sesgada de lo que es. Las dos cifras son honestas y ninguna es la otra redondeada.
method.denominator.body.where: Method paragraph body. Exists because a reader who downloads the payload and recomputes gets a different figure from the one on screen.
method.denominator.body.note: Added after a data reporter was pitched the open payload. The page showed 30% (20/67) while the file said 31.7% (19/60) and nothing on either surface said why. Deliberately does NOT quote the denominator as a number: the page cannot reliably derive it (items.length - headlineCount only works when no headline bill was already rule-selected), and crossCuttingOf is absent from the committed payload.

privacy.lead.en: What this page counts, and what it does not.
privacy.lead.es: Qué cuenta esta página y qué no.
privacy.lead.where: Privacy paragraph lead, in the authorship card.

privacy.body.en: It counts visits — how many people came and which link sent them — using Vercel's analytics, which sets no cookies and cannot follow you to another site. Your answers are not part of that. They never leave your browser: there is no server to send them to, and the page makes no network request while you answer. That is not a promise, it is checked on every build — the test answers five questions and fails if a single byte goes out.
privacy.body.es: Cuenta visitas —cuántas personas entraron y qué enlace las trajo— con la analítica de Vercel, que no usa cookies y no puede seguirle a otro sitio. Sus respuestas no forman parte de eso. Nunca salen de su navegador: no hay ningún servidor al que enviarlas, y la página no hace ninguna petición de red mientras usted responde. Eso no es una promesa, se comprueba en cada compilación: la prueba responde cinco preguntas y falla si sale un solo byte.
privacy.body.where: Privacy paragraph body, in the authorship card, before the contact line.
privacy.body.note: The last sentence is the load-bearing one and must stay true. verify_site.mjs answers five questions and asserts nothing but fonts and the page-view beacon goes out. If that check is ever removed or weakened, this sentence becomes a lie and has to be reworded first.

intro.subhead.en: How Vikki Goodwin, Gina Hinojosa and James Talarico voted in the Texas House, checked against your own answers.
intro.subhead.es: Cómo votaron Vikki Goodwin, Gina Hinojosa y James Talarico en la Cámara de Texas, comparado con sus propias respuestas.
intro.subhead.where: Static subhead under the h1, above the explainer.
intro.subhead.note: Exists because the three names appeared NOWHERE in the static html — they are rendered client-side from the payload, so the queries this page answers best ("James Talarico voting record") had nothing for a crawler to match. Kept short and plain to match the deliberately low reading level of the explainer below it; it is a real subhead for a reader, not keyword filler.

rep.heading.en: And how did your own representative vote?
rep.heading.where: Heading of the district lookup section.

rep.lede.en: The three above are running for other offices. This is the person who actually represents you in the Texas House, scored the same way and on the same votes you answered.
rep.lede.es: Los tres de arriba compiten por otros cargos. Esta es la persona que de verdad le representa en la Cámara de Texas, calificada igual y sobre los mismos votos que usted respondió.
rep.lede.note: Deliberately carries NO item count. It used to interpolate activeItems().length, which contradicted the coverage line beneath it in 7-issue mode.

rep.findDistrict.en: If you do not know your district, it is on your voter registration card, or search your address at {link}.
rep.findDistrict.es: Si no sabe su distrito, está en su tarjeta de registro de votante, o busque su domicilio en {link}.
rep.findDistrict.where: Help text under the district input. {link} is an anchor to the state lookup.
rep.findDistrict.note: The site does not geocode an address itself: that needs a third-party call and the CSP is connect-src self. Pointing at the state's own tool is honest and costs nothing.

rep.noSuchDistrict.en: District {d} has no sitting member in this record. 149 of the 150 seats are filled.
rep.noSuchDistrict.es: El distrito {d} no tiene miembro en funciones en este registro. 149 de los 150 escaños están ocupados.

rep.outOfRange.en: The Texas House has districts 1 to 150.
rep.outOfRange.es: La Cámara de Texas tiene distritos del 1 al 150.
rep.outOfRange.where: Shown for a number outside the range.

rep.noVotes.en: {name} cast none of the {items} votes you were asked about, so there is no alignment to report. That is an absence, not a middling result.
rep.noVotes.es: {name} no emitió ninguno de los {items} votos sobre los que se le preguntó, así que no hay coincidencia que informar. Es una ausencia, no un resultado intermedio.
rep.noVotes.where: Shown when the member voted on none of the items.

rep.answerFirst.en: Answer a few votes first, then come back and look your representative up.
rep.answerFirst.es: Responda algunos votos primero y luego vuelva a buscar a su representante.
rep.answerFirst.where: Shown before the reader has answered anything.

rep.coverage.en: Their record covers {voted} of the {items} questions in the full set, and {n} of those overlap what you answered. A vote they missed is dropped for them alone, not counted against them.
rep.coverage.es: Su historial cubre {voted} de las {items} preguntas del conjunto completo, y {n} de esas coinciden con lo que usted respondió. Un voto que no emitieron se descarta solo para ellos, no se cuenta en su contra.
rep.coverage.where: Coverage line under a member result.
rep.coverage.note: Holds both denominators together on purpose. Split across two sentences they read as one number contradicting another.

rep.thin.en: Only {n} of your answers overlap their record, so this number is heavily shrunk toward zero and should not be read closely.
rep.thin.es: Solo {n} de sus respuestas coinciden con su historial, así que esta cifra está muy contraída hacia cero y no debería leerse de cerca.
rep.thin.where: Extra warning when overlap is under 10.

rep.loadFailed.en: Could not load the member record. The rest of the page is unaffected; the file is at {link} if you want to check it yourself.
rep.loadFailed.es: No se pudo cargar el registro de miembros. El resto de la página no se ve afectada; el archivo está en {link} si quiere comprobarlo usted mismo.

rep.excluded.en: {n} people voted in this session but are not in this lookup, having left the House since. A district whose seat changed hands will show its current member with a partial record.
rep.excluded.es: {n} personas votaron en esta sesión pero no están en esta búsqueda, porque dejaron la Cámara desde entonces. Un distrito cuyo escaño cambió de manos mostrará a su miembro actual con un historial parcial.
rep.excluded.note: Load-bearing honesty: one of the excluded members cast 3,352 votes, a full session. Without this line a partial record looks like a lazy member rather than a seat that changed hands.

rep.zipLabel.where: Label on the ZIP input in the representative panel.

rep.zipSpans.note: A split ZIP is a real ambiguity, not a defect in the data. Saying so is better than picking the largest share and hoping.

rep.zipUnknown.es: {zip} no es un código postal de Texas en este registro.
rep.zipUnknown.where: Shown for a five-digit ZIP that is not in the crosswalk.
